args.text: Can you start a short Sev 1 recap for Thea's exec call: when the Superior sync broke on 4 Nov, who found the cause, and when it was resolved. Post it here as a draft.

DRAFT – Sev 1 recap for Thea's exec call (from #inc-qfl-sev1)
• What broke: On 4 Nov 2025 the dock schedule sync at Quarrendon Freight Lines' Superior terminal wedged, starting around 6:40 AM (their time). Driver tablets were spinning and trucks backed up at the guard shack. Dana raised the Sev 1 at 7:02 AM.
• Who found the cause: Samir Patel (on call). He started on it at 7:08 AM and identified the culprit at 7:17 AM as a deadlocked webhook listener on the QFL tenant.
• Mitigation: Thea joined a bridge for about 20 minutes. Samir cleared the stuck jobs, and Superior got a partial sync around 8:15 AM. Some inbound trailers were still duplicating.
• Resolved: Samir deployed a hotfix and ran a replay script, and the sync was clean in real time at 2:38 PM. Thea confirmed from the yard and Dana closed the incident at 2:44 PM.
Note: the channel doesn't state the time zone for the posted times, and the postmortem notes aren't in the channel, so root-cause detail beyond the listener deadlock isn't covered. Please check before sending.
